visibleTestCases.title: Initial Value and Increment
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin P = counter_actor:start(10), ok = counter_actor:increment(P, 5), Res = counter_actor:get_value(P), counter_actor:stop(P), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Initializes counter with 10, increments by 5, and retrieves 15.

visibleTestCases.title: Increment and Decrement Sequence
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin P = counter_actor:start(0), counter_actor:increment(P, 50), counter_actor:decrement(P, 20), Res = counter_actor:get_value(P), counter_actor:stop(P), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Applies increment of 50 followed by decrement of 20, verifying final value 30.
